# The Afrofuturist

> > A platform exploring Afrofuturism, Black futures, and the intersection of African diaspora culture with science fiction, technology, and speculative narratives.

The Afrofuturist (the-afrofuturist.com) is a digital publication and community space dedicated to Afrofuturist thought, creativity, and cultural commentary. The site features content related to BT (Beyond Tomorrow) and explores themes of Black identity, futurism, and technological imagination.

## Key Topics

- Afrofuturism
- BT (Beyond Tomorrow)
- Black futures
- African diaspora culture
- Science fiction
- Speculative narratives
- Privacy policy
- Data collection
- User rights
- GDPR compliance
- Data security

## Site Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://the-afrofuturist.com/privacy): Privacy policy for The Afrofuturist covering data collection, user rights, cookies, data security, and GDPR compliance
